	COLDWAR_SWE_national_mediation_round = {
		icon = GFX_decision_obtain_foreign_investment
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_open
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first_accepted
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_accepted
		}
		available = {
			ROOT = {
				AND = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = 0.002
						}
					}
					check_variable = {
						var = treasury
						value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
						compare = greater_than_or_equals
					}
				}
			}
		}
		cost = 0
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_open
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_first_accepted
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_second_accepted
					ROOT = {
						AND = {
							set_temp_variable = {
								COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget = {
									value = gdp_total
									multiply = 0.002
								}
							}
							check_variable = {
								var = treasury
								value = COLDWAR_SWE_national_required_budget
								compare = greater_than_or_equals
							}
						}
					}
				}
				ROOT = {
					set_temp_variable = {
						treasury_change = {
							value = gdp_total
							multiply = -0.002
						}
					}
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
				}
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_round_completed
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_close_mediation_effect = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_SWE_national_mediation_withdraw = {
		icon = GFX_decision_obtain_foreign_investment
		visible = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_open
		}
		cost = 0
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_mediation_open
				}
				COLDWAR_SWE_national_close_mediation_effect = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 0
		}
	}
}
